items.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023
items.q: And Chubby Jackson talked about like what is this — this does not groove.

ctx.x: Well he had a profound effect on me from the word go. And it makes my attempts seem so pretentious. But you know I have to think of it as just a kid who’s having fun writing and doesn’t know any better. Now I know better.

There’s an interesting anecdote about when Stravinsky wrote the “Ebony Concerto” for the Woody Herman band, and it was apparently quite the scene. And Chubby Jackson talked about like what is this — this does not groove.
That’s right. Stravinsky. Yeah. Well. I was going to mention something but I can’t — what were we talking about just before that?
